verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so API parity with the UI is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no public API at all, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The Excel connector and the inbound ERP/CRM/HRIS integrations are adjacent features, not a programmatic API covering UI functionality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
